_comment: 2020 Porsche 911 Carrera S coupe (992.1, US), 3.0 L twin-turbo flat six, 8-speed PDK, rear-wheel drive, PTV Plus. Draft from lab/cars/porsche992-research.md; model fields (model_scene, rig, collision, mount) come from the fit.
name: 911 Carrera S

sources.mass: 3,382 lb PDK (Porsche 2020 US spec sheet); DIN 1515 kg (EU sheet). Split 38/62 and CG 0.46 m are estimates.
sources.engine: Porsche: 443 hp at 6500 rpm, 390 lb-ft at 2300-5000 rpm, 7500 rpm maximum. Curve outside the plateau is an estimate.
sources.gearing: PDK ratios and 3.12 rear axle ratio (EU sheet; US sheet 3.39 x 0.92 constant = 3.12). Reverse 3.99 EU, 3.96 US.
sources.brakes: 350 x 34 mm 6-piston front, 350 x 28 mm 4-piston rear (Porsche). Torques are estimates; front share 0.60 stays above the ideal up to 1.06 g.
sources.diff: PTV Plus electronic rear lock with brake vectoring (Porsche EU sheet; standard on the North American Carrera S PDK, secondary). Bias 3.0/1.8 stands in.
sources.steering: 15.0:1 on centre to about 12.25:1, 11.2 m circle (Porsche). 2.3 turns is an estimate.
sources.aero: EU Cd 0.29 x 2.07 m2 = 0.600; US Cd 0.31. 0.62 m2 is the midpoint.
sources.tyre_pressure: 36/45 psi for 245/35ZR20 and 305/30ZR21 (tirepressure.com, secondary). Staggered tyres: rear size in the file, axle_grip for the front.
sources.calibration: Car and Driver: 3.0 s 0-60 PDK (via Gear Patrol); 136 ft 70-0 and 1.06 g from the 2020 manual Carrera S on the same tyres (Yahoo reprint).
sources.estimates: Weight split, CG, inertia, springs, bars, dampers, alignment, brake torques, clutch, shift time, diff bias, ESC gradient, tyre curve, axle_grip. static_mu.
sources.static_mu: static_mu is required by the loader: 1.10 (992, matches tmeasy_peak_mu_x 1.15 less load sensitivity) / 0.97 (TT) are estimates.
sources.reference_corner_load_n: mass_kg x 9.81 / 4 (computed from the published mass).

_model_note: No model yet (ticket #41). model_scene is a placeholder because the loader requires a non-empty value; the Cars spec replaces it with the fitted model. Physics fields beyond the draft are left to the Handling thread (#35).
